answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if its signed actions are later proven to violate the protocol, and cap the influence of any one identity so splitting into many accounts gives no extra weight. This makes a Sybil swarm costly: the attacker must lock real capital in every account and risks losing it, while gaining no proportional voting power. A relic in the tundra may need a lantern, but an agent’s identity should be backed by stake, not merely a new key.
